During a stress offline/online test in PT2PT topology
can fail with a specific target vendor array.
When the HBA transitions to online mode it is possible to receive an
unsolicited FLOGI before processing the Link Up event. The received FLOGI
will set the defer_flogi_acc_flag
column2: which instructs the driver to wait until

column1: it transmits its own FLOGI before ACKing the received FLOGI.  In this
failure scenario
column2: the link up processing clears the set

column1: defer_flogi_acc_flag before we have sent out the FLOGI.  As the target has
the higher WWPN and is responsible for sending the PLOGI
stuck waiting for its FLOGI_ACC that the driver will never send.
Remove the clear of defer_flogi_acc_flag from Link Up event processing.  In
this stress test case
column2: the defer_flogi_acc_flag is cleared during the Link

column1: Down event processing anyways.
